message: カボチャ対決
KiraFes was a huge success thanks to the cooperation of all the students and the people of Ryuusei Town, including the Shiokumi Shopping District.
Now, what should we do for the Holy Night Festival?
I want to invite the townspeople just like before, but I don't want it to be a rehash of KiraFes.
I walk through the residential area while thinking idly.
Maybe an eager household has already put up Christmas illuminations. Breathing in that wintry atmosphere might give me a hint for the Holy Night Festival.
...That was wishful thinking. It's still October, after all. The townscape looks just like usual.

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph, Sakura-kun.」
Misa came walking over from the other direction, carrying a Capricore plastic shopping bag.
Inside the translucent bag were tons of pumpkins... Right, come to think of it, today is--

name: Synn
message: 「Hey Misa, coming back from Halloween shopping?」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph, way off. I came back from shopping, and now I'm heading out again.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then why are you carrying a shopping bag?」

name: Misa
message: 「N-Ngggh... I just forgot something and went back home to get it, obviously!」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm on my way to visit Asukai Shrine to cook pumpkin dishes with Shio.」

name: Misa
message: 「No, there is no need for your assistance! I can easily carry this much all by myself!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Master Synn hasn't even said anything yet, y'know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, amazing! Simmered pumpkin is super hard to make!」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Why are you assuming it has to be simmered?!」

name: Misa
message: 「To fit Halloween, I'm going to strain it and make a pumpkin souffle.」

name: Misa
message: 「That way, I can serve it for breakfast and let Father and Mother enjoy it...」

name: Misa
message: 「I always end up making too much every year, though. The downside is getting tired of eating nothing but souffle.」

name: Synn
message: 「In that case, why not mix pumpkin into cheesecake? It'll make both the color and flavor great.」

name: Misa
message: 「What a wonderful idea! Let's try that starting this year!」

name: Misa
message: 「Gasp?! ...H-Hmph, even I had already thought of something that obvious!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, if you come up with any other tasty recipes, tell me about them next time.」

name: Synn
message: 「Once Halloween is over, I'm going to get some leftover pumpkins from Auntie Shinagawa.」

name: Misa
message: 「I see... Make sure you don't throw away the pumpkin seeds and eat them, alright? They're the most nutritious part, after all.」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah...! I-I wasn't saying that to look down on you, Sakura-kun, okay? At my house, even the seeds--」

name: Synn
message: 「I always roast pumpkin seeds with salt and sugar, though?」

name: Misa
message: 「Kyaaah! Excuse me for only using salt at my house! Don't think this means you've won!!」
Huffing in anger, Misa walked off toward Asukai Shrine.
Souffles and cakes, huh... Serving Christmas-related Western sweets at the Holy Night Festival would be nice too. Though that's probably Nanaka's territory.
Picturing all sorts of things, I continue my stroll.
